title: Traditional Terrine with Graham Cracker Crust
description: A twist on the classic French terrine, this dish features a crunchy graham cracker crust and a rich, earthy filling, perfect for a comforting dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Prepare the graham cracker crust by mixing the crushed crackers with melted butter and pressing into a 9x5-inch loaf pan.
In a separate bowl, mix together the terrine, chicken broth, mushroom duxelles, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Pour the terrine mixture into the prepared loaf pan over the graham cracker crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.
Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
